turns.query: There's a raft of trash and foam pinned against our pod by the wind. Is any of that showing up in the data?
turns.noRelevantChunks: No chunk describes detection, counting or characterisation of floating debris; the DataPod's six measured parameters are declared in the system prompt, not in a document.

turns.query: Would it move any of the numbers at all, even indirectly?
turns.noRelevantChunks: Pure-deixis follow-up — 'it' and 'any of the numbers' name nothing retrievable. Unanswerable in isolation (◆G11).
